concerns.text: T038b specifies final_results.csv columns 'subject_id, metric, genre, r, p_raw, p_adj, p_adj_bh' while also requiring conformance to contracts/correlations.schema.yaml, whose required fields are 'metric_name, network_type, genre, spearman_r, p_raw, p_adjusted, is_significant, power_achieved, permutation_count' with additionalProperties: false. An implementer cannot satisfy both column lists; the task is not deterministically executable as written. Align the column list with the contract (and drop the per-subject subject_id column, meaningless for correlation-level rows).

T077's verification requires the documented end-to-end command to 'execute' and produce real result rows on 5 subjects, but T046/T038c mandate exit code 1 with ERR_UNDERPOWERED when N < 85. The thin run will necessarily halt at the gate, so T077's verification condition is unsatisfiable as specified. Define how the pilot bypasses or tolerates the gate (e.g., a documented --pilot flag exempt from the N gate) or restate the expected outcome as 'halts with ERR_UNDERPOWERED after producing pilot artifacts'.

The data model and data-flow declare the results artifact as data/derived/correlations.csv, but every task writes data/derived/final_results.csv. An implementer following the data model produces a file no task verifies. Pick one canonical filename and update the other document.

T072's example 'Sampled N=50 from N=100 using seed 42' describes exactly the sampling the Plan forbids ('NO SAMPLING TO N=50... halts if N < 85'). The example invites an implementer to reintroduce underpowered sampling. Replace with an example consistent with the N>=85 hard gate or state explicitly that sampling below N=85 must trigger ERR_UNDERPOWERED.

T075's power validation says 'compare calculated power against a known reference (e.g., published G*Power output)' and 'halt if power deviates >1% from reference' without naming the specific reference values (N, effect size, expected power). The implementer cannot deterministically choose the reference, and the 1% tolerance is tighter than typical analytic approximations allow. Name the exact reference case (e.g., N=85, r=0.3, alpha=0.05 two-sided) and its expected power value or computation method.
